When was the last time you had a real AHA moment? A moment of sudden realization, inspiration, or insight. Together with an extraordinary collective of musicians, artists, and storytellers, we’ve created an experience filled with AHA moments—designed to open us to wonder, joy, connection, and perhaps even a new way of seeing ourselves and each other. Visit ahalive.com for presale signup and travel packages and I’ll see you in Las Vegas✨".
